deps.edn.reason: The git floors on test, edn and text point at repositories that are bundled here as kotoba.test, kotoba.edn and kotoba.text; they become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. :paths and :aliases are unchanged.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the source and test paths.

test/cbor/core_golden_test.cljk.reason: The suite reads its golden corpus by a path relative to the old repository root (test/cbor/golden.edn). The library suites run from the root of this repository, so the path names the corpus where it now lives (lib/org.ietf.cbor/test/cbor/golden.edn). Nothing else in the file changes.
